dedupe_keys.name: residential building gross floor area by country bauhaus der erde material stock study

description: This dataset gives estimated residential building gross floor area, in square metres, for each country, from a globally consistent method for estimating residential floor area and material stock at fine spatial resolution. It was published on Zenodo on 1 July 2025 by Adrian Foong, Stepan Svintsov, Tobias Seydewitz, Anne Holsten and Barbara K. Reck of Bauhaus der Erde, as a supplement to an article in Resources, Conservation and Recycling. The method combines the latest public datasets on key building parameters with material intensities; the deposited table is the country-level floor area. Coverage: countries worldwide. Access: one small CSV on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: validation found the floor area estimates about 30 to 40 percent below official statistics in the countries and regions tested. Simulation uses: sizing residential stock for material flow, embodied carbon and renovation scenarios where national statistics are missing. Related records: the Material stock maps and the Melbourne embodied GHG dataset.
